STORMBREAK CLIFFS — Sea-battered granite ramparts rise two thousand feet from churning waves; foreground: tide pools glisten among barnacle-crusted boulders where terns wheel; midground: sheer cliff faces streaked white with guano and salt, ruined watchtower clinging to an outcrop; deep distance: island pillars emerge from fog banks, connected by gossamer rope bridges swaying in gale winds; sky: bruised storm clouds split by cathedral shafts of silver light.

EMBERVEIL BASIN — Volcanic caldera glowing with molten fissures beneath twilight sky; foreground: obsidian shards catch firelight, steam vents hiss between cooled magma flows; midground: rivers of orange lava snake through black stone valleys, igniting sporadic gas plumes into blue flame; deep distance: the far crater wall rises into shadow, its peak lost in ash clouds; sky: ember particles drift upward like inverse stars against deepening indigo.

THORNWOOD DEEPS — Ancient forest where ironbark trees tower forty meters, their trunks wider than houses; foreground: moss-slick roots create labyrinthine passages, mushroom clusters glow faint blue; midground: the canopy forms a living cathedral ceiling, sunbeams pierce through in dusty columns where deer graze on fern carpets; deep distance: the forest floor descends into mist-filled ravines where treetops become islands; sky: branches lattice overhead, filtering daylight to emerald twilight.

CRYSTALDEEP CHASM — Glacier-carved canyon where walls of blue ice rise vertical for miles; foreground: icicle formations drip into frozen pools reflecting aurora light; midground: the canyon floor winds between cathedral-scale ice pillars carved by ancient melt-rivers, ice caves glow cyan from within; deep distance: the chasm narrows to a slot where walls nearly meet, disappearing into mountain heart; sky: stars visible even at midday through the narrow gap, aurora curtains dance overhead.

GOLDENMERE VALE — Autumn valley ablaze with maple and birch in crimson and gold; foreground: smooth river stones border a crystal stream, fallen leaves drift on slow current; midground: the valley floor spreads in waves of color, elk herds move like shadows through the brilliance, abandoned millhouse stands moss-covered; deep distance: mountains rise purple-blue, their snowcaps catching sunset fire; sky: geese formations arrow southward across peach-and-lavender clouds.

SHADOWFEN REACHES — Mangrove swamp where twisted roots form cathedral arches above black water; foreground: barnacles and crabs cluster on exposed roots at low tide, bioluminescent algae pulse in pools; midground: channels wind between root-islands, egrets stalk through shallows, sunken boat ribs protrude from mud; deep distance: the swamp blurs into mist where giant trees fade to silhouettes; sky: oppressive humidity hazes the canopy, sun reduced to diffuse bronze glow.

STARFALL EXPANSE — Desert of white salt flats stretching to horizon under night sky; foreground: crystalline salt formations catch starlight like diamonds, scorpion tracks cross pristine crust; midground: the flat mirrors the heavens perfectly, creating illusion of walking through space, distant rock formations rise like islands; deep distance: mountains ring the basin as teeth on horizon, heat shimmer visible even at night; sky: the galaxy spreads wall-to-wall, meteor trails streak regularly, aurora-like glow haunts northern rim.

WYRMSCAR PEAKS — Mountain range where peaks pierce cloudmass to float as islands in sky; foreground: alpine flowers dot rocky meadow, marmots whistle warnings from boulder perches; midground: ridgeline drops away into nothing, clouds fill valleys completely, only mountaintops visible as archipelago; deep distance: peaks march into blue infinity, each fainter and more ethereal; sky: the sun a white disc above cloudmass, peaks cast shadows on cloud-ocean below.

CINDERFALL PLAIN — Volcanic wasteland of black sand dunes and smoking fumaroles; foreground: volcanic glass fragments catch red glow from fissures, hardy lichens cling to cooled lava; midground: ash dunes ripple toward distant peaks, geysers erupt in columns of steam, lava flows visible as orange veins in twilight; deep distance: volcanic cones rise in layers, the farthest lost in haze and smoke; sky: ash clouds perpetually veil stars, lightning flickers within the volcanic plume.

MISTWOOD HEART — Primeval forest perpetually shrouded in silver fog; foreground: massive roots create tunnels, foxfire mushrooms glow green-blue on rotting logs; midground: trees wider than towers vanish into mist fifteen meters up, deer move as ghosts between trunks, streams appear and disappear; deep distance: the forest has no visible end, only deepening layers of gray and silver; sky: invisible above canopy, only filtered light suggesting day from night.

IRONFJORD DEPTHS — Fjord where granite walls rise sheer for thousands of feet from black water; foreground: seaweed clings to tide-smoothed boulders, seal colonies bask on rocks; midground: the fjord cuts knife-straight into mountain heart, waterfalls plunge from cliff edges losing themselves in spray before reaching sea; deep distance: the fjord narrows to vertical slot, glacier visible as blue wall at terminus; sky: a ribbon overhead between cliffs, eagles soar at eye-level to cliff-top viewers.

DUSKBLOOM MOORS — Highland moorland rolling under purple heather and storm-threat sky; foreground: wind-twisted hawthorn huddles low, rabbit warren openings dot hillsides; midground: hills cascade in waves toward horizon, standing stones march in ancient lines, abandoned crofts sink into peat; deep distance: mountains emerge dark and serrated from mist, storm front visible as curtain of rain; sky: clouds race low and ragged, sun breaks through in spotlight shafts.

GLOWDEEP CAVERNS — Subterranean cathedral of bioluminescent fungi and crystal formations; foreground: stalagmites drip with luminous slime, cave crickets reflect blue-green light; midground: cavern opens to impossible scale, columns thick as castle towers support ceiling lost in darkness, underground lake mirrors the glow perfectly; deep distance: side passages recede into constellation-like points of light, mineral veins glow violet in rock face; sky: ceiling invisible, only dripping water and bat colonies suggest overhead limit.

WINDSHEAR CANYON — Slot canyon where sandstone walls meet overhead in flowing curves; foreground: flash-flood debris wedged between narrows, sand ripples show recent wind passage; midground: canyon walls rise in waves of orange, red, and cream, light bounces between curves creating otherworldly glow, bighorn sheep navigate impossible ledges; deep distance: canyon twists from view, only suggestions of sky-slits visible; sky: visible only as ribbons of blue between sculptural stone, sun creates moving spotlight effects.

FROSTWHISPER TAIGA — Northern forest of snow-laden pines under aurora light; foreground: wolf tracks cross fresh powder, ice crystals coat every needle and twig; midground: forest marches in ordered ranks up slopes, frozen lake spreads mirror-smooth, moose browse on willow thickets; deep distance: mountains rise white-on-white, only shadows defining ridgelines; sky: aurora curtains shimmer green and violet, stars pierce clear black between.

SUNKEN GARDEN OF AETHELMERE — Overgrown palace courtyard where nature reclaims marble and gold; foreground: moss devours carved reliefs, root systems crack fountain basins where frogs chorus; midground: colonnades lean drunkenly, their capitals sprouting full trees, statues disappear beneath ivy, reflecting pools now lily-choked; deep distance: palace wings fade into jungle growth, towers visible only as vine-wrapped shapes; sky: canopy has reclaimed courtyards, sun penetrates only in shafts through strategic gaps.

SERPENT'S SPINE RIDGE — Mountain ridgeline so narrow the trail allows single-file passage above abyss; foreground: loose scree threatens footing, alpine gentians bloom in rock cracks; midground: ridge undulates like dragon backbone for miles, drops away thousands of feet on both sides into cloud-filled valleys; deep distance: ridge connects to main massif where glaciers cling to north faces; sky: so close to clouds they pass through the ridge, ravens ride thermals at eye level.

TIDEMARK ARCHIPELAGO — Island chain where sea-stacks rise like cathedral spires from emerald water; foreground: tide pools teem with anemones and urchins, driftwood piles create labyrinths; midground: islands of all sizes dot the seascape, sea arches frame distant views, cormorant colonies blacken cliff faces; deep distance: islands fade through atmospheric layers from green to blue to purple; sky: seabirds wheel in thousands, clouds build over warm currents into towering cumulus.

ASHENVALE BIRCHWOOD — Winter birch forest where white trunks create vertical striping against snow; foreground: rabbit tracks cross drifts, frozen stream visible beneath ice-sheet like dark vein; midground: birch trunks march in infinite repetition creating optical illusion, owls perch in high branches, deer browse on bark; deep distance: forest fades through snow-haze to suggestion and ghost; sky: overcast pearl-gray, snow begins to fall in large slow flakes adding to accumulation.

BASILISK RUINS — Collapsed fortress half-devoured by forest and time; foreground: carved stones lie moss-covered in fern beds, salamanders bask on sun-warmed rubble; midground: walls stand roofless, trees grow from interior courtyards, great hall open to sky where swallows nest, arched windows frame forest views; deep distance: towers lean at dangerous angles, one has fallen to create stone-and-vine hill; sky: visible through gothic windows and collapsed vaulting, clouds drift through empty halls.

STORMCROWN MASSIF — Alpine peaks where permanent storm systems crown summits in lightning; foreground: mountain flowers bloom in brief growing season, marmot colonies among boulder fields; midground: slopes rise through vegetation zones toward bare rock, glaciers spill between ridges, abandoned mining camp slowly collapses; deep distance: the massif rises in tiers, each summit darker and more forbidding, storm perpetually crowns highest peak; sky: lightning arcs between peaks in continuous display, thunder echoes through valleys.

MOONWELL GLADE — Forest clearing where ancient spring feeds luminous pool; foreground: smooth stones ring pool edge worn by centuries, fireflies dance among sedges; midground: clearing spreads in perfect circle, ring of oak trees so large their canopies nearly touch overhead, deer approach pool to drink under moon; deep distance: forest walls are impenetrable darkness beyond firefly-light; sky: canopy opens to reveal full moon perfectly centered, stars visible in the gap, pool reflects sky so perfectly surface disappears.

REDSTONE GORGE — River canyon where iron-rich cliffs glow crimson in sunset; foreground: river-smoothed boulders create rapids, otter slides visible on bank; midground: canyon walls rise in stepped layers of red, orange, and cream, river winds in tight meanders, petroglyphs visible on sheltered faces; deep distance: gorge deepens and narrows, becomes slot-canyon where walls meet overhead; sky: visible as ribbon overhead, sunset turns walls to flame, swifts dive through canyon hunting insects.

ICEBREAK TUNDRA — Arctic plain where pressure ridges create ice mountains under northern lights; foreground: permafrost patterns create geometric designs, ptarmigan tracks cross snow; midground: pressure ridges thrust ice blocks three stories high in chaotic walls, arctic fox hunts among formations, wind scours snow into artistic shapes; deep distance: tundra extends flat to horizon where sea and sky merge in white; sky: aurora dominates in curtains and spirals of green fire, stars visible between displays.

ELDERFALL CASCADE — Waterfall descending through multiple tiers from mountain height to valley floor; foreground: spray creates rainbow in mist, ferns drip with constant moisture, salmon leap lower falls; midground: water drops in seven major tiers, each creating its own pool and ecology, cliff swallows nest behind water curtain; deep distance: the falls originate from glacier terminus barely visible at mountain summit miles above; sky: mist rises to cloud height, making waterfall seem to emerge from heaven itself, eagles soar through spray columns hunting.
